description: Use this when the user wants to stop or restart checks of a site or one of its checks, for example during planned work. Returns the new state and what it means: pausing a site stops its checks, content checks and dependencies, holds its DNS watch alerts, and resolves its open automatic incidents, but its cron jobs keep alerting until each is paused; pausing frees no room on the plan; resuming must fit the plan's active monitors. Not for scheduling maintenance windows or deleting a monitor: those are in the dashboard.

check.description: One of the site's content checks, dependencies or cron jobs, by id or name; leave out for the whole site.

paused.description: True to pause, false to resume.

site.description: The site, by id, name or part of its URL.

name: set_monitor_paused
title: Pause or resume a monitor
